answer: Quadratic identity bonding prices sybil armies out. Each identity in a stake-fingerprint cluster pays n times the base bond: identity 1 locks 1,000 POA, identity 2 locks 2,000, identity 1,000 locks 1,000,000. Spinning up 1,000 fakes costs 500.5 million POA before any acts, while one honest agent pays 1,000. Clustering spots wallets cut from the same vine of funding, and fresh keys never reset the multiplier. Graders read each chain like surveyors checking every terrace against the atlas. It is a parking meter doubling hourly: the first hour is pocket change, the hundredth bankrupts you.
